amendment1.blindness: Written while collection was in progress. No confirmation score, digest comparison, aggregate, slice or interim estimate had been computed or inspected; only row counts were read.

trigger.what: One DEVELOPMENT game of other arms (stage P, shard 30, Mac) was rejected by native quality validation.
trigger.warning: [server-ai] game=sim-<id> strategy v0.8 proposal declined: type=melee_attack reason=attack_not_available
trigger.nature: A known pre-existing native anomaly of the default policy (the engine declines a stale native melee proposal and the server falls back); it has closed earlier unrelated studies. It is not produced by the candidate rule, which only changes which root action is selected.
trigger.observedRate: one rejection in roughly 12,000 complete games played by this study before the amendment
trigger.whyAmend: The original quality gate required zero rejected games. At that base rate about one rejection is expected by chance among 10,800 confirmation games, which would void the study for a reason unrelated to the hypothesis.

rule.certifiedClass: A confirmation game is a native-refusal rejection only if it is terminal and its ONLY quality errors match ^\[server-ai\] game=sim-\d+ strategy v0\.8 proposal declined: type=melee_attack reason=attack_not_available$.
rule.adverseImputation: The family of a native-refusal rejection is NOT dropped. Both seats of that family are scored as the worst completion for the candidate: candidate arm loss (0), current arm win (1). This holds whichever arm contained the refusal.
rule.gates: Every registered gate (gain, 95% lower bound, changed families, slice floors, independent reconstruction) is evaluated on all 2,700 families with this imputation.
rule.cap: At most 13 imputed families (0.5%). More than 13, or any rejection outside the certified class (another warning, a non-terminal game, a thrown error), fails the quality gate as originally registered.
rule.reporting: Every rejected game is listed with its case, arm, input hash and warning. The recorded real outcomes of rejected games are reported only as a descriptive sensitivity estimate.

operational: macOS xargs cannot carry the inline resume loop; the Mac uses run-list3.sh/run-one-shard.sh with the same contract. No game input, source file in the manifest, candidate, bank, gate threshold, bootstrap or cutoff changes.
The Mac joined collection at about 19:42 UTC after that launcher error; no game had started there before.
